sections.heading: 1. Introduction
content: Welcome to ZoneUp! These Terms and Conditions ('Terms') govern your access to and use of our mobile application (the 'App'). By accessing or using the App, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree to these Terms, please do not use the App.

sections.heading: 1A. Who we are and our role
content: ZoneUp app is operated by Zoneup, Trichy, Tamil Nadu ("ZoneUp", "we", "us").

ZoneUp is an intermediary under the Information Technology Act, 2000. We provide a platform where users post and share content and connect with people nearby. We do not create, edit, endorse or verify content posted by users, and users are solely responsible for what they post and how they act.

sections.heading: 2. Eligibility
content: You must be at least 18 years old to use the App. By using the App, you represent and warrant that you meet this eligibility requirement. ZoneUp is not intended for children under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18. If we become aware that we have collected information from a child under 18, we will take steps to delete such information.

sections.heading: 3.1 Account Creation
content: To access certain features of the App, you must create an account. You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during the registration process and to update such information as necessary.

sections.heading: 3.2 Account Security
content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.

sections.heading: 4. User conduct and prohibited content
content: You must not post, share, upload, send or otherwise make available any content that:
1. belongs to another person and to which you have no right;
2. is obscene, pornographic, paedophilic, or invades another person's privacy, including bodily privacy;
3. insults or harasses anyone on the basis of gender, or is racially or ethnically objectionable;
4. relates to or encourages money laundering, gambling or any illegal activity;
5. promotes enmity between groups or incites violence;
6. is harmful to children, or involves any form of child sexual abuse material, exploitation or inappropriate contact with minors;
7. infringes any patent, trademark, copyright or other intellectual property right;
8. deceives or misleads people about where a message came from, or knowingly spreads information that is false or misleading;
9. impersonates another person or entity, or misrepresents your affiliation with anyone;
10. is synthetically generated or altered (for example, deepfakes or AI-generated images, audio or video) in a way that misleads people about a real person or event, unless clearly labelled;
11. threatens the unity, integrity, defence, security or sovereignty of India, friendly relations with other countries, or public order, or incites any offence;
12. contains viruses, malware or any code designed to disrupt or damage any system;
13. is an online game or real-money game not permitted under Indian law, or advertises one; or
14. otherwise violates any law in force.
You also must not harass, threaten, stalk or harm other users, create fake accounts, use the App to collect other users' information, or interfere with the App, its servers or networks.
Breaking these rules may lead to removal of content, suspension or termination of your account, and reporting to law enforcement where required by law.

sections.heading: 4A. Interactions with other users and meeting in person
content: ZoneUp helps people nearby discover each other and connect. You are solely responsible for your interactions with other users, both on the App and offline.

We do not conduct criminal background checks or screen users, and we do not verify the identity, statements, intentions or conduct of users. We cannot guarantee that any user is who they claim to be or that they are safe to meet.

If you choose to meet anyone you connected with through ZoneUp, you do so at your own risk. Meet in public places, tell someone you trust where you are going, and follow our Safety Tips. ZoneUp is not responsible for the conduct of any user, on or off the App, and is not a party to any arrangement made between users.
If you feel unsafe or are in danger, contact the police immediately by calling 112. You can also report a user through the App.

sections.heading: 4B. Specific features
content: Alert posts: Alert posts let you notify people nearby. ZoneUp is not an emergency service, and we do not monitor, respond to or guarantee that anyone will see or act on an Alert post. In an emergency, always call 112 or the relevant emergency service first. Do not post false or misleading alerts.

Services, classes and offers: Users may post about services, classes, events or offers (for example, a painter, an electrician or a dance class). ZoneUp is not a party to any arrangement between users, and does not verify the skills, licences, pricing, quality or reliability of anyone offering services. Any payment, dispute or loss is solely between the users involved.
Gender-only posts: Gender is self-declared by users. ZoneUp cannot guarantee that a gender-only post is seen only by people of that gender, and does not verify the gender of users.

Burn posts: Burn posts disappear from view after a set time. Other users may still take screenshots or recordings before a post disappears, and ZoneUp may retain related information as required by law (see section 5A).

Location: ZoneUp uses your location to show you content and people nearby. Other users see your approximate area, not your exact location. Content you post to the Nearby feed is public and can be seen by anyone using ZoneUp, including people outside your area.

Direct messages (DMs) and communities: DMs (one-to-one chats): text messages in DMs are end-to-end encrypted, so in normal operation only the sender and recipient can read them. Photos, videos, voice notes and other media shared in DMs are also end-to-end encrypted, and are kept in encrypted form on our servers for up to one year, then deleted. If you forward media from a DM to a community, the forwarded copy is no longer end-to-end encrypted, and ZoneUp stores that copy so community members can see it. Communities: text messages in communities are not end-to-end encrypted. They are encrypted while travelling between your device and our servers, and ZoneUp relays them to community members without keeping them on our servers after delivery, except for content that has been reported, or where we are required by law to retain or disclose it. Do not share anything in a community that you would not want other members to see, save or share.

sections.heading: 5.1 Your Content
content: You retain ownership of any content you post on the App. By posting content, you grant us a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, distribute, modify, and display your content in connection with the App.

Content posted to the Nearby Feed, public communities, and profile pictures are public. You grant ZoneUp a worldwide, royalty-free license to host, display, and distribute this public content across the platform.

sections.heading: 5.2 Our Content
content: All materials on the App, including text, graphics, logos, and images, are the property of ZoneUp or its licensors and are protected by copyright and other intellectual property laws. You agree not to reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works from our content without our express permission.

sections.heading: 5A. Reporting, moderation and retention
content: You can report any post, comment, message or user through the App, or by writing to our Grievance Officer (section 11A). We review reports and act on them in line with applicable law, including the timelines under the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, as amended.

We may remove or disable access to any content, and suspend or terminate any account, if we believe it breaks these Terms or the law, or if we are required to by a court order or a lawful direction from a government authority. We are not obliged to monitor content before it is posted.

Where required by law, we may retain information about removed content and deleted accounts, including registration details, for 180 days or longer, and may share it with law enforcement agencies in response to a lawful request.
We will remind users of these Terms and our Privacy Policy from time to time, as required by law.

sections.heading: 6. Termination
content: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account or access to the App at any time, with or without notice, if we believe you have violated these Terms or if we believe it is necessary to protect the security or integrity of the App.

sections.heading: 7.1 Disclaimers
content: The App is provided 'as is' and 'as available' without warranties of any kind, either express or implied. We do not warrant that the App will be uninterrupted, secure, or error-free.

sections.heading: 7.2 Limitation of Liability
content: To the fullest extent permitted by law, ZoneUp and its affiliates will not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or any loss of profits or revenues, whether incurred directly or indirectly, or any loss of data, use, goodwill, or other intangible losses, resulting from (a) your use of or inability to use the App; (b) any unauthorized access to or use of our servers and/or any personal information stored therein; (c) any interruption or cessation of transmission to or from the App; or (d) any bugs, viruses, trojan horses, or the like that may be transmitted to or through the App by any third party.

In addition, to the fullest extent permitted by law, ZoneUp, its proprietor, affiliates and team members will not be liable for any loss, injury, damage or claim arising from (e) the content, statements or conduct of any user or third party, whether on the App or offline, including any meeting, transaction or interaction between users; or (f) any reliance on an Alert post or any other content on the App.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, our total liability to you for all claims relating to the App or these Terms will not exceed the greater of the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim, or INR 1,000.

sections.heading: 7.3 Messaging Encryption and Technical Disclaimer
content: ZoneUp provides end-to-end encrypted messaging on a best-effort basis. ZoneUp, its operators, and affiliates shall not be held liable for any unintended decryption, interception, or exposure of communications caused by software defects, bugs, device vulnerabilities, or unauthorized third-party access.
All chat media is subject to a strict 1-year Time-To-Live (TTL) retention schedule. ZoneUp is not responsible for any loss of data or media occurring after this period.

sections.heading: 8. Indemnification
content: You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless ZoneUp and its affiliates from and against any claims, liabilities, damages, losses, and expenses, including, without limitation, reasonable legal and accounting fees, arising out of or in any way connected with your access to or use of the App or your violation of these Terms.

sections.heading: 9. Governing law and jurisdiction
content: These Terms are governed by the laws of India, without regard to conflict of law principles. Subject to section 11A (Grievance Officer), the courts at Bengaluru, Karnataka shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising from these Terms or your use of the App.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to These Terms
content: We may modify these Terms from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the updated Terms on the App and updating the 'Last Updated' date. Your continued use of the App after the posting of changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated Terms.

sections.heading: 11. Contact Us
content: If you have any questions about these Terms and Conditions, please contact us at support@zoneup.in

sections.heading: 11A. Grievance Officer
content: In line with the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the rules made under it, our Grievance Officer is: Grievance Officer, ZoneUp. Email: support@zoneup.in.

You can complain about any content or user, or about how we handled your earlier report. We will acknowledge your complaint within 24 hours and resolve it within the time required by law. Complaints about content that shows a person in a sexual act or conduct, nudity, or that impersonates someone, including morphed images, will be acted on as a priority.
If you are not satisfied with the Grievance Officer's decision, you may appeal to the Grievance Appellate Committee set up by the Government of India, within the time allowed under the rules.
